```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## ##sumstat(06-10-26) all Summary stats tables in one report (HTML / PDF / Word)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, error = TRUE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
## table style chosen in the app (classic = original look)
if (exists("doe_tstyle_knitr_hook", mode = "function")) doe_tstyle_knitr_hook(params$table_style)
```

```{r table-style-css, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## HTML: the same table style as on screen, tables centred
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  css <- "table { margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: auto !important; } caption { text-align: center; }"
  if (exists("doe_tstyle_css", mode = "function")) css <- paste(css, doe_tstyle_css(params$table_style))
  cat("<style>\n", css, "\n</style>\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r tables, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
tabs <- params$tables
if (is.null(tabs) || length(tabs) == 0) {
  cat("No summary statistics available.\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_along(tabs)) {
    variable_name <- names(tabs)[i]
    tb <- as.data.frame(tabs[[i]], check.names = FALSE)
    cap <- paste0("Summary statistics of ", variable_name)

    if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
      out <- tb %>%
        kableExtra::kbl(caption = cap, align = "c", row.names = FALSE) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "bordered",
                                  full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
        kableExtra::kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                                  html_font = params$font)
      cat(out, "\n\n")
    } else if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
      ## caption is not escaped by kbl, so escape LaTeX specials (e.g. plant_height)
      cap_tex <- gsub("([_%&#$])", "\\\\\\1", cap)
      out <- tb %>%
        kableExtra::kbl(caption = cap_tex, label = paste0("sumstat", i), format = "latex", align = "c",
                        booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", row.names = FALSE) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(position = "center", full_width = FALSE,
                                  latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header", "scale_down", "H"))
      cat(out, "\n\n")
    } else {
      ## Word: pipe table, centred columns
      print(knitr::kable(tb, format = "pipe", caption = cap, align = "c", row.names = FALSE))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
  cat("\nSD = Standard Deviation; SE = Standard Error; CV(%) = Coefficient of Variation\n")
}
```
